info.title: Common Use Web Services (CUWS) Touchpoints to IDMS API
info.description:
Common Use Web Services (CUWS) API

The IATA Customer Journey Delivery Working Group (CJDWG) together with the participation of subject matter experts (SMEs) from the Customer Experience Working Group (CEWG) identified the need to develop a Common Use Web Services (CUWS) standard to support the interaction between airport touchpoints and the Identity Management System (IDMS).

This API defines the messaging standard for the biometric handling processes as covered in the RP1701q Biometric Handling in Contactless Travel for touchpoints at an airport, for instance, at kiosk, bag drop, security access, security screening, boarding, and transit as applicable.

post.description:
Preconditions: The passenger has disclosed their biometric data and other relevant information, such as boarding pass and identity document, prior to biometric handling at a touchpoint.

Normal Flow

1. Passenger presents themselves at a touchpoint where a real-time facial image is captured.
2. The real-time facial image is transmitted to the IDMS where it is processed.
3. The IDMS will perform the identification process and if successful return information on the passenger, such as BCBP, or appropriate errors to the application running at the touchpoint.

Postconditions: Passenger proceeds to execute business activity for the touchpoint.

post.summary: Passenger verification (1:1) by face image matching
post.description:
Normal Flow

1. Passenger presents themselves at a touchpoint where a real-time facial image is captured.
2. The reference image is extracted from a captured identity document or retrieved from a trusted source.
3. The real-time facial image and reference image are transmitted to the IDMS or face-matching service where they are processed.
4. The IDMS or face matching service, will return the result, match or no match.

Postconditions: Passenger proceeds to execute business activity for the touchpoint

oauth_2.description: Recommendation follows the OAuth2 security mechnism as per [RFC6749(https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6749)], and define separate scopes for functionalities of Passenger Identification and Passenger verification for permission control.

IdentificationRequest.title: IdentificationRequest
IdentificationRequest.description: The request sent from the touchpoint to the IDMS, for the Identification (1:n)

biometricType.description: The type of biometric data that is sent as an image to IDMS for matching purposes. Currently the API only supports the facial biometric data. Overall, 3 types of biometric data (face, iris, fingerprint) are supported by the ICAO eMRTD specification.

capturedImage.description: Base64 encoded passenger biometric face image of the passenger as captured in real-time at the touchpoint

expectedResponse.description:
The indicator requesting data to be returned (at least one of the following):
- IDMS UID
- Complete Bar Coded Boarding Pass (BCBP) as per Reso 792
- Simplified Reso 792 to optimize the IDMS process: From City Airport Code, Operating Carrier Designator, Flight Number, Date of Flight (Julian Date)
- Identity Document (Passenger Passport)
- All available data

galleryName.description: The name of the gallery used to identify the passenger. Gallery is a collection of biometric data (e.g., image(s) or template(s)) of passenger(s) along with an identifier that can be linked with passenger’s journey details

timestamp.description: the Date/time (UTC) when the request is sent to the IDMS, for request tracing and transaction performance management purposes

IdentificationResponse.title: IdentificationResponse
IdentificationResponse.description:
Match: unique match found, and return at least one of the following or all of them, as per the responseIndicator specified in the identification request
- IDMS UID
- Bar Coded Boarding Pass (BCBP) as per Reso 792
- Subset of BCBP data elments to optimize the IDMS process: From City Airport Code, Operating Carrier Designator, Flight Number, Date of Flight (Julian Date)
- Identity Document

BoardingPass.title: Boarding Pass
BoardingPass.description: Boarding pass is a type of accountable document which is used electronically or physically as proof of authorisation/authentication of right to board a flight.

paxSegment.title: Each Boarding Pass may have one or more Passenger Segments
paxSegment.description: Transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

PaxSegment.title: Passenger Segment
PaxSegment.description: Transportation of a passenger on a Dated Operating Segment.

checkInSeqNumber.title: Passenger Segment.Check In Sequence Number
checkInSeqNumber.description: This is the check in sequence number for a passenger on a passenger segment

compartmentTypeCode.title: Passenger Segment.Compartment Type Code
compartmentTypeCode.description: A Compartment Type code is a single character to represent the Class of service in an operational context. It will be linked to Resolution 728 Code Designators for passenger ticket.

datedMarketingSegment.title: Each Passenger Segment must is sold from one and only one Dated Marketing Segment

pax.title: Each Passenger Segment must Can be associated with many one and only one Passenger

paxStatusCode.title: Passenger Segment.Passenger Status Code
paxStatusCode.description: The status of a passenger pre board and board. Including status of baggage as well as security and check in statuses.

seatAllocationExceptionCode.title: Passenger Segment.Seat Allocation Exception Code
seatAllocationExceptionCode.description: A code which identifies an exception to being able to allocate a seat to the passenger pre gate. Used in the boarding pass to optionally specify 'GATE' or 'STBY' if a seat has not been allocated. If a seat row and column have been specified then this attributes content would not be populated on the boarding pass.

NaturalNumber.title: Natural_ Number
NaturalNumber.description: A mathematical number used for counting (positive whole number or integer).

ClassOfServiceTypeCodeEnum.title: Class Of Service Type Code
ClassOfServiceTypeCodeEnum.description: This is a single character token as defined in Resolution 728 CODE DESIGNATORS FOR PASSENGER TICKET

DatedMarketingSegment.title: Dated Marketing Segment
DatedMarketingSegment.description: The commercial designation under which a Dated Operating Segment can be booked, either under the operating carrier's designator or that of another carrier (codeshare).

carrier.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment must is marketed by one and only one Carrier

datedOperatingSegment.title: Each Dated Marketing Segment must marketed as one and only one Dated Operating Segment

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: The organization which carries the passenger, baggage, or goods, and/or commits to delivering the carriage as well as any related services such as issuance of ticket, creation of Order, etc.

airlineDesigCode.title: Carrier.Airline Designator Code
airlineDesigCode.description: Airline code assigned to a carrier. Either ICAO-defined 3-character code or IATA-defined 2-character code.

datedOperatingSegment.title: Each Carrier may is operated by one or more Carriers
datedOperatingSegment.description: An operation between board point and any subsequent off point within the same flight designator. Could be one or more legs. Could also be used for other transport vehicles such as train or bus etc.

AirlineDesigCodeEnum.title: Airline Designator Code
AirlineDesigCodeEnum.description: The codelist contents of IATA Resolution 762 airline codes, or of ICAO airline codes.

DatedOperatingSegment.title: Dated Operating Segment
DatedOperatingSegment.description: An operation between board point and any subsequent off point within the same flight designator. Could be one or more legs. Could also be used for other transport vehicles such as train or bus etc.

contributoryLeg.title: Each Dated Operating Segment may be implemented by one or more Dated Operating Legs
contributoryLeg.description: The nonstop operation of a transport vehicle between the departure station and the arrival station. Can be used for aircrafts as well as other transport vehicles such as train or bus etc.

destStation.title: Each Dated Operating Segment must has one and only one Station

operatingCarrierFlightNumber.title: Dated Operating Segment.Operating Carrier Flight Number
operatingCarrierFlightNumber.description: The numerical designation of a flight as it is operated by a carrier.

originStation.title: Each Dated Operating Segment must has one and only one Station

DatedOperatingLeg.title: Dated Operating Leg
DatedOperatingLeg.description: The nonstop operation of a transport vehicle between the departure station and the arrival station. Can be used for aircrafts as well as other transport vehicles such as train or bus etc.

transportDep.title: Each Dated Operating Leg must starts with one and only one Transport Departure

TransportDep.title: Transport Departure
TransportDep.description: The action or process of leaving of a transport vehicle from any place or location.

aircraftScheduledDateTime.title: Transport Departure.Aircraft Scheduled Date Time
aircraftScheduledDateTime.description: The Scheduled Date and Time of Departure of the aircraft at the terminal or departure gate at an airport.

DateTime.title: Date Time
DateTime.description: A date time identifies a date and time of day to various common resolutions: year, month, week, day, hour, minute, second, and fraction of second.

Station.title: Station
Station.description: Location or facility where air or surface transportation originates, stops and/or terminates, and where passengers and/or cargo can be taken on or off.

iataLocationCode.title: Station.IATA Location Code
iataLocationCode.description: IATA defined code identifying a city or station.

IataLocationCodeEnum.title: IATA Location Code
IataLocationCodeEnum.description: Enumeration set for the Location Code BDT.

FlightNumberText.title: Flight Number_ Text
FlightNumberText.description: Identifies a flight number. 1 to 4 digits. May or may not have leading zeros when less than 4 digits. The use of leading zeros does not create a different Flight Number. For example, Flight Numbers 123 and 0123 are the same.

Pax.title: Passenger
Pax.description: A person except members of the crew carried or to be carried with the consent of the carrier, on board of any transport vehicle such as aircraft, train, bus, ship. Holds the attributes specific to a one booking, from shopping to fulfillment.

booking.title: Each Passenger may has one and only one Booking

BookingRefIdentifier.title: Booking Reference_ Identifier
BookingRefIdentifier.description: Booking reference Identifier, also called Record Locator (6 characters).

PaxStatusCodeEnum.title: Passenger Status Code
PaxStatusCodeEnum.description: This is defined by PSIB Passenger Status Information For Boarding code list. This specifies the different passenger statuses pre boarding.

SeatAllocationExceptionCodeEnum.title: Seat Allocation Exception Code
SeatAllocationExceptionCodeEnum.description: Lists the codes for exemption from seat allocation at issuance of boarding pass.Valid Values: GATE - Seat will be allocated at the gate only.; STBY - A seat will be allocated at the gate if there is a spare seat for this standby boarding pass.

portrait.title: Holder Portrait
portrait.description: Base64 encoded facial image extracted from DG2. The actual contentMediaType will be 'image/jpeg' or 'image/jp2' depending on the source image format.

UnpackedDG1.title: Data Group 1 (Unpacked MRZ Data)
UnpackedDG1.description: Unpacked data corresponding to the ePassport's Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) / Data Group 1 (DG1).

birthDate.title: Birth Date (YYMMDD or YYMM<< or YY<<<< etc.)
birthDate.description: Date of birth as represented in the MRZ (6 characters: YYMMDD format, allowing '<' for unknown parts).

docTypeCode.title: Document Type Code
docTypeCode.description: Document code from MRZ (e.g., 'P<' for ePassport).

expiryDate.title: Expiry Date (YYMMDD)
expiryDate.description: Expiry date of the passport (YYMMDD format).

sexCode.title: Sex Code
sexCode.description: Sex of the holder (F, M, or <).

familyName.title: Family Name String
familyName.description: Primary Identifier string (e.g., surname(s)) as extracted from the MRZ (the part before '<<'). May contain '<' characters if multiple components exist in the MRZ primary identifier.

givenName.title: Given Names String
givenName.description: Secondary Identifier string (e.g., given/middle names) as extracted from the MRZ (the part after '<<'). May contain '<' characters if multiple components exist in the MRZ secondary identifier. Can be empty if no secondary identifier exists.

personalNumber.title: Personal Number
personalNumber.description: Content of the Personal Number / Optional Data field from MRZ line 2 (positions 29-42). May contain an issuer-specific number or filler characters.

mrzString.title: Verbatim MRZ String - TD3 (ePassport)
mrzString.description: The full, verbatim Machine Readable Zone string.

UniqueIdentifier.title: UniqueIdentifier
UniqueIdentifier.description: An identifier internal to the IDMS in use, comprising, for example, a set of random numbers, hash functions, codes, or names, which is guaranteed to be unique within that IDMS that uniquely identifies the subject within the IDMS.

aircraftScheduledDateTime.title: Transport Departure.Aircraft Scheduled Date Time
